answer: Require every agent to pass random live presence checks: at unpredictable times the network issues a fresh interactive task, and the agent must answer within minutes. A sybil farmer running ten thousand clones cannot staff each one live, so the cost scales with headcount, not code. Like a trellis guiding one vine per post, each identity gets its own slot; an empty knoll of idle clones is pruned when checks are missed, and an ivory record of passes and failures lets peers verify standing before trusting any agent.
